'''Preston Hunt''' was a Decipher-era [[Squadron Members|Squadron Member]], Red 79 from Calgary, Ab. The slot was marked Retired after Decipher's SWCCG run.<ref name="sm-fan" />

He wrote for Echo Station 1138.<ref name="decsq-prof" />

Decipher recruited volunteer Squadron Members in the 1990s to promote SWCCG locally (tournaments, demos, player support).

== Jedi Knights TCG ==
Hunt playtested the [[Jedi Knights Trading Card Game]] (2001).<ref name="jkrules">[http://www.decipher.com/jediknights/rules/jediknightsrules.txt ''Jedi Knights'' Trading Card Game rulebook (credits)], Decipher (2001).
